#!/bin/bash
# Imange -- archlinux:latest

# Define Variables
local="/mnt/server"
type=$TYPE
version=$VERSION
java_version="25"
link="null"

mkdir -p $local
cd $local

# Install Packages
pacman -Sy --noconfirm curl jq openjdk$java_version-src

if [ $type = "vanilla" ]; then
	if [ $version = "latest" ]; then
		version=`curl -s https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest.json | jq -r ".latest.release"`
	fi

	link=`curl -s https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest.json | jq --arg v $version -r '.versions | .[] | select(.id== $v) | .url'`
	link=`curl -s $link | jq -r '.downloads.server.url'`
elif [ $type = "paper" ] || [ $type = "folia" ]; then
	if [ $version = "latest" ]; then
		version=`curl -s https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/$type/versions | jq -r '.versions[0].version.id'`
	fi
	
	link=`curl -s https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/$type/versions/$version/builds/latest | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".url'`
elif [ $type = "fabric" ]; then
	if [ $version = "latest" ]; then
		version=`curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/game | jq -r '.[] | select(.stable== true) | .version' | head -1`
	fi
	
	fabric_version=`curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | jq -r '.[0].version'`
	loader_version=`curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | jq -r '.[] | select(.stable== true) | .version' | head -1`
	link="https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/$version/$loader_version/$fabric_version/server/jar"
elif [ $type = "forge" ]; then
	if [ $version = "latest" ]; then
		version=`curl -s https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/promotions_slim.json | jq -r '.promos | to_entries[] | .key | split("-")[0]' | tail -1`
	fi
	
	forge_version=`curl -s https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/promotions_slim.json | jq --arg v $version-latest -r '.promos | .[$v]'`
	rm -f server.jar
	curl -s https://maven.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/$version-$forge_version/forge-$version-$forge_version-installer.jar -o installer.jar
	java -jar installer.jar --installServer
	rm -f installer.jar installer.jar.log README.txt run.* user_jvm_args.txt
	mv forge-*.jar server.jar
else
	echo -e "Invalid sever type."
	exit
fi

if [ "$link" = "null" ] && [ $type != "forge" ] ; then
	echo -e "Invalid download link."
	exit
fi

# Download server.jar
if [ $type != "forge" ]; then
	rm -f server.jar
	curl -s $link -o server.jar
fi

# Accept EULA
echo eula=true >> eula.txt
